sections.title: How weapons work
paragraphs: Lead designer Ez Jämsen describes Frostrail as guns-first rather than melee-first. Pistols, shotguns, rifles, and machine guns form the announced firearm families, with basic melee available earlier and a secondary melee action on ranged weapons.
Ammunition is framed as a valuable resource, so the official design messaging treats combat as a serious cost rather than an unlimited shooting gallery.
bullets: WWI-influenced firearm direction
Crafting is planned for all guns
Modular parts and weapon-modifying stations
No reliable public damage comparison yet

sections.title: Crafting & modifications
paragraphs: The developers say firearms are craftable and modular. The Bolt-Action Rifle has specifically been used to demonstrate changing weapon parts at a modifying station. Recipes, part names, quality tiers, slot counts, and stat modifiers are not public.

sections.title: Weapon data FAQ
paragraphs: Why are there no damage rankings? Because the available reference mockup contains invented presentation data and FakeFish has not published a comparable, final stat set. This wiki will add build-numbered values when a public or permitted test can verify them.
bullets: Mockup weapon names are not treated as game content
Trailer frames identify visual direction, not numeric stats
Beta values will be labeled by build and verification date

sections.title: Resource loop
paragraphs: The crew leaves the train to scavenge settlements, wreckage, ruins, bunkers, strongholds, and dungeons, then brings recovered materials back to onboard stations. Resources support weapons, equipment, repair, expansion, storage, heat, and motion.

Aku Jauhiainen gives one concrete production example: metal scraps are processed into slag metal and then pure metal. He says wood and plastic follow similar refinement logic, but does not publish every intermediate name or ratio.
bullets: Scavenge the frozen levels
Return materials to the train
Refine metal scraps → slag metal → pure metal
Use comparable refining systems for wood and plastic

sections.title: Confirmed crafting loop
paragraphs: Players scavenge materials in the frozen world, return to the train, and use onboard production facilities to strengthen both crew and locomotive. Weapons are planned to be craftable and modular rather than purely random drops.

The clearest published refinement example converts metal scraps into slag metal and then pure metal. The founder says wood and plastic are refined in similar ways, connecting raw salvage to higher-grade production inputs.
bullets: Recover metal, cloth, plastic, fuel, and other supplies
Refine metal scraps → slag metal → pure metal
Use train-mounted benches, repair, cooking, and weapon stations
Expand the train with more facilities and storage
